finalText:
Found it. `src/core/settings.js:17` was setting `maxRetries` from a variable named `retries` that never existed, so the build crashed with a `ReferenceError` at the link step.

I changed it to read `env.retries` instead, falling back to `3`. The build now finishes clean: exit `0`, "build finished in 41.7s with 3 warnings, 0 errors."

Those 3 warnings are just noise from the fake compiler (a deprecated API, an unused export, a circular import) — nothing blocking, but worth a look if you want a truly quiet log.
